_note: General advice for first-time travellers. Tagalog is a draft that needs native review.

title.fil: Mga fixer at pekeng nagbebenta ng tiket

body.en: Some people outside ports offer to buy tickets for you or sell "reserved" seats. Buy only at the official ticket office or authorized outlets, and always get an official receipt.
body.fil: May mga tao sa labas ng pantalan na nag-aalok na sila ang bibili ng tiket o nagbebenta ng "reserved" na upuan. Bumili lamang sa opisyal na ticket office o awtorisadong outlet, at laging humingi ng opisyal na resibo.

body.en: Someone may grab your bags and then ask for a big fee. If you need help, use accredited porters with IDs and agree on the price first.
body.fil: Maaaring may kumuha ng inyong bag at saka hihingi ng malaking bayad. Kung kailangan ng tulong, gumamit ng accredited na porter na may ID at pagkasunduan muna ang presyo.

body.en: A "special trip" tricycle or van carries only you, so it costs more. Ask for the regular fare and agree on the price before riding.
body.fil: Ang "special trip" na tricycle o van ay para sa inyo lang, kaya mas mahal. Itanong ang regular na pamasahe at pagkasunduan ang presyo bago sumakay.

body.en: If someone says your trip is cancelled and offers another ride, check with the shipping line counter or the Coast Guard first.
body.fil: Kung may magsabing kanselado ang inyong biyahe at mag-alok ng ibang sasakyan, magtanong muna sa counter ng shipping line o sa Coast Guard.

body.en: Book only through the shipping line's official website, app or page. Never send money to a personal account for tickets.
body.fil: Mag-book lamang sa opisyal na website, app o page ng shipping line. Huwag magpadala ng pera sa personal na account para sa tiket.

title.en: Know where the life jackets are
title.fil: Alamin kung nasaan ang life jacket

body.en: When you board, find the nearest life jackets and exits, and listen to the safety briefing.
body.fil: Pagsakay, hanapin ang pinakamalapit na life jacket at labasan, at makinig sa safety briefing.

body.en: Keep your phone, cash and ID in a small bag you carry at all times, even when you sleep on the ship.
body.fil: Ilagay ang cellphone, pera at ID sa maliit na bag na lagi ninyong dala, kahit natutulog sa barko.

body.en: Before leaving, tell your family which ship and bus you will take and when you expect to arrive.
body.fil: Bago umalis, sabihin sa pamilya kung anong barko at bus ang sasakyan at kailan inaasahang darating.

title.en: Do not board an overloaded boat
title.fil: Huwag sumakay sa sobrang punong bangka

body.en: If a small boat looks overloaded or the sea is rough, wait for the next trip. Your safety comes first.
body.fil: Kung mukhang sobrang puno ang maliit na bangka o malakas ang alon, hintayin ang susunod na biyahe. Kaligtasan muna.

body.en: Trips are cancelled when the weather is dangerous. Ask the shipping line about rebooking or refunds, keep your ticket, and check the app for other routes.
body.fil: Kinakansela ang biyahe kapag mapanganib ang panahon. Magtanong sa shipping line tungkol sa rebooking o refund, itago ang tiket, at tingnan sa app ang ibang ruta.

body.en: Stay inside the port area, keep your phone charged, and ask Coast Guard or port staff for help. Call 911 in an emergency.
body.fil: Manatili sa loob ng pantalan, panatilihing may charge ang cellphone, at humingi ng tulong sa Coast Guard o kawani ng pantalan. Tumawag sa 911 kung may emergency.
